programme.title: Body Melt
programme.desc: Residents of peaceful Pebbles Court, Homesville, are being used unknowingly as test experiments for a new 'Body Drug' that causes rapid body decomposition (melting skin etc.) and painful death.

programme.title: Bottle Rocket
programme.desc: Upon his release from a mental hospital following a nervous breakdown, the directionless Anthony joins his friend Dignan, who seems far less sane than the former. Dignan has hatched a harebrained scheme for an as-yet-unspecified crime spree that somehow involves his former boss, the (supposedly) legendary Mr. Henry.

programme.title: Braindead
programme.desc: When a Sumatran rat-monkey bites Lionel Cosgrove's mother, she's transformed into a zombie and begins killing (and transforming) the entire town while Lionel races to keep things under control.

programme.title: Delta Delta Die!
programme.desc: Mother Fitch (Julie Strain) and her girls have an insatiable taste for men; their flesh that is. Together they attempt to end the sorority's reign of culinary terror that grips the California campus.

programme.title: Destroy All Neighbors
programme.desc: William Brown, a neurotic, self-absorbed musician determined to finish his prog-rock magnum opus, faces a creative roadblock in the form of a noisy and grotesque neighbor named Vlad. Finally working up the nerve to demand that Vlad keep it down, William inadvertently decapitates him. But, while attempting to cover up one murder, William’s accidental reign of terror causes victims to pile up and become undead corpses who torment and create more bloody detours on his road to prog-rock Valhalla.

programme.title: Doug Stanhope: No Refunds
programme.desc: Not all stand-up comedy is spot-cleaned and pre-packaged for the masses. programme.title: Drop Box
programme.desc: 'Drop Box' is a comedy about a spoiled pop princess who accidentally returns her sex tape to a local video store, then must try everything to get it back from an uncooperative clerk. Fearing that if she fails, her next big hit won't be musical.

programme.title: Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas
programme.desc: Raoul Duke and his attorney Dr. Gonzo drive a red convertible across the Mojave desert to Las Vegas with a suitcase full of drugs to cover a motorcycle race. As their consumption of drugs increases at an alarming rate, the stoned duo trash their hotel room and fear legal repercussions. Duke begins to drive back to L.A., but after an odd run-in with a cop, he returns to Sin City and continues his wild drug binge.

programme.title: Adaptation.
programme.desc: Charlie Kaufman is a confused L.A. screenwriter overwhelmed by feelings of inadequacy, sexual frustration, self-loathing, and by the screenwriting ambitions of his freeloading twin brother Donald. programme.title: All the Single Ladies
programme.desc: When her friends unpleasantly surprise her with a singles party Tiek (Lisa Smit) feels like she landed in her own personal hell. But then she meets the mysterious hobo Jip (Tomer Pawlicki) and suddenly the night takes an unexpected, and Disney-like, turn.

programme.title: American Movie
